ConVarData::m_eVarType.via: tier0!0x18020F144 (same function): `movsx rax, word ptr [rcx+28h]` = the int16 EConVarType that indexes the 88-byte type-traits table (entry names bool,int16,uint16,int32,uint32,int64,uint64,float32,float64,string,color,vector2,vector3,vector4,qangle,vectorws = EConVarType 0..15)
